message: What, if anything, would a reader lose if you removed the feather-touch sentence you keep revisiting? Could Rohin’s reported C2 example—comparing predictions against a distinguishing calculation, then revising its judgment—help you compare versions here, without importing arithmetic into the story? Would closer thought about the detail’s purpose settle your uncertainty, or would a small revision provide better evidence? What thinking or writing step will you complete now on your own judgment? What observation in the actual passage would change that choice? What finding, uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn?
